profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Sight Machine
profile.summary: Full-Stack Python/Qt Desktop Software Developer with experience in MVVC applications, and coordinating projects with cross-functional teams and customers, in addition to Agile Scrum and DevOps practices.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Full-Stack Desktop Software Developer

-  Python and Qt/QML stack (MVVC pattern) for multiple desktop applications in use 
by thousands of hospitals worldwide as well as internal manufacturing lines. 

-  Performed individual contributor work as well as leading team members through projects and 
coordinating with UI/UX and other technical teams. 

-  Created applications for manufacturing plant administrators and operators to streamline 
device testing and reporting using a dynamically generated UI to be configured in the field. 

-  Created end-user application for downloading data from Masimo devices and performing 
data analysis and reporting for medical professionals. 

-  Created Bluetooth stack API for use in our applications for connecting to Masimo devices. 

-  Implemented multiple proprietary device communication protocols over serial and TCP.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full-Stack .NET Web Developer

-	Pipeline management and reporting web service used by engineers and technicians to deploy firmware and ensure hard drive reliability (.NET MVC/MS SQL/Vue.js)

-	Streamlined firmware engineers’ failure analysis process by developing a scalable comparison framework, giving them more insight into the impact of their code changes

-	Led efforts to integrate cross-functional development processes to ensure code quality

-	Experience implementing and consuming RESTful APIs & SOAP services

-	Developed client applications for system management (Python/Bash/Batch/Java)

-	Certified Scrum Master through Scrum Alliance (Valid 2018 – 2020)

positions.title: Firmware Test Developer
positions.description:
-	Improved coverage of real-world testing by developing a SATA trace reproduction engine to simulate realistic end-user workloads (Java)

-	Enhanced firmware engineers’ ability to iterate more effectively on features by creating an interface for visualizing performance across different builds (d3js)

positions.title: Android Mobile Application Developer
positions.description:
-	OAUTH Authentication to allow students to view classes, grades and other information
-	Facilitated campus dept. outreach to students by incorporating their services into the app

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
-	PREDATOR MQ-9 Unmanned Aerial Vehicle System, Firmware development (C)
-	Implemented backup protocol for GPS system failure and loss-of-link failsafe

positions.title: Robotics Academy Intern
positions.description:
Worked on a Lunar Micro Rover
(a small, inexpensive, customizable rover platform to complete a variety of missions on the lunar surface)

Worked on Remote Deployment system for the lander
(designed a system to remotely deploy the rover from the lander via computer)

positions.title: Website Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Analyzed performance using server-side (PHP Xdebug) and client-side (Firebug YSlow) metrics on a Drupal-based site.
- Developed a curriculum for a robotics course on the FreshBrain website.
- Assisted online users with site usage and accessibility

educations.schoolName: California Polytechnic State University-San Luis Obispo

projects.title: GetBev
projects.description:
Beverage locator with support for crowd-sourced data developed in a team of 4. (Android)
•	Established an algorithm to locate and get information about drinks sorted by distance or price.
•	Stored user submissions data and displayed analytics about the users.
